_comment: Primitives TestServer commons feature-set.json (design 'Feature Configuration'):
the authoritative Feature_Catalog. Each language's server declares the
supported/unsupported half of every feature here in its own feature-config.json;
the union must equal this catalog. Each feature names one primitive operation
family a Language_Server may implement.
NOT TESTED: primitives in the Dafny AwsCryptographyPrimitives library that have
no model operation, no Feature here, and no Tests. Add one by adding the
operations to model/primitives-test-server.smithy, the Feature to this catalog,
and the Tests, together.
- RSA (encrypt/decrypt, GetRSAKeyModulusLength): the native Rust primitives
have no RSA.
- ECDH (key generation, public-key validation, shared secret, point
compression): the native Rust primitives have no ECDH.
- PEM key parsing (Dafny TestRSA PEM tests, TestECDH
GetPublicKeyFromPrivatePem): only RSA and ECDH keys are parsed from PEM, so
this lands with those two.
- AES-KDF-CTR: used only by the DB-ESDK; not needed until a DB-ESDK consumer is.
- KdfCounterMode's purpose/nonce form (Dafny TestKDF_TestVectors C.1-C.5): the
model's KbkdfCtrHmac takes the full fixed input, so only the raw-derive
vectors (B.1-B.10) are ported.
- Constant-time comparison (Dafny ConstantTime.dfy): a property of one
implementation's internals, not observable through the wire contract.
